actions.name: Build artifacts (language dispatcher)

Detects the project's languages (or uses the `language` input) and a `build` flag filter, then dispatches to the language-specific build actions: rust-build, c-build, cpp-build, csharp-build, java-maven-build, java-gradle-build, tauri-build, python-build, flutter-build, android-build, ios-build, kmp-android-build. templates.name: Build
templates.description: Thin build workflow — copy into any project, set optional `language` and
templates.content:
# Thin build workflow — copy into any project, set optional `language` and
# `build` filters. Everything (language detection + dispatch to the per-language
# build actions: rust-build, c-build, cpp-build, csharp-build, java-maven-build,
# java-gradle-build, tauri-build, python-build, flutter-build, android-build,
# ios-build, kmp-android-build) lives in the shared `build` action and updates
# automatically at @v1 (or @latest for rolling updates).
#
# Default trigger: workflow_dispatch (Actions tab → Run workflow), optional
# push/PR triggers. Version bump the project files, set the tag, done.
name: Build

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      language:
        description: >-
          Main stack(s): auto | rust | tauri | c | cpp | csharp | maven |
          gradle | python | flutter | android | ios | kmp (comma-separated OK)
        required: false
        type: string
        default: auto
      build:
        description: >-
          Comma-separated build filters: cargo, tauri, python, flutter,
          android, ios, kmp, c, cpp, csharp, java, all
        required: false
        type: string
        default: all
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main"]

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build artifacts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: OseMine/workflows/.github/actions/build@v1
        with:
          language: ${{ inputs.language || 'auto' }}
          build: ${{ inputs.build || 'all' }}
          # --- optional toolchain overrides ---
          # rust-toolchain: stable
          # java-version: 17
          # java-distribution: temurin
          # dotnet-version: "9.0"
          # python-version: "3.12"
          # --- signing for mobile (only when building android/kmp signed) ---
          # android-signed: "false"
          # keystore: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE }}
          # keystore-store-password: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_STORE_PASSWORD }}
          # keystore-key-alias: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_KEY_ALIAS }}
          # keystore-key-password: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_KEY_PASSWORD }}

templates.name: CI
templates.description: Thin CI workflow — copy into any project. Set `language` (or a repo
templates.content:
# Thin CI workflow — copy into any project. Set `language` (or a repo
# variable `CI_LANGUAGE`) and done. All lint/check/test logic lives in the
# shared `ci` action and updates automatically at @v1 (or @latest for rolling).
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  ci:
    name: CI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: OseMine/workflows/.github/actions/ci@v1
        with:
          language: ${{ vars.CI_LANGUAGE || 'auto' }}
          # auto | rust | tauri | node | python | flutter | kmp | php | lua
          # comma lists allowed, e.g. 'rust,node'
          rust-toolchain: stable

templates.name: CodeQL Analysis
templates.content:
name: CodeQL Analysis

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 4 * * 1" # Monday 04:17 UTC

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  analyze:
    name: Analyze (${{ matrix.language }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      security-events: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        language: ["javascript", "python"]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
        with:
          languages: ${{ matrix.language }}

      - name: Autobuild
        uses: github/codeql-action/autobuild@v3

      - name: Perform CodeQL Analysis
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3
        with:
          category: "/language:${{ matrix.language }}"

templates.name: Deploy Website
templates.content:
name: Deploy Website

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
    paths:
      - "web/**"
      - ".github/workflows/deploy-web.yml"
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]
    paths:
      - "web/**"
      - ".github/workflows/deploy-web.yml"

concurrency:
  group: deploy-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: web/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: web
        run: npm ci

      - name: Type-check
        working-directory: web
        run: npx tsc --noEmit

      - name: Build
        working-directory: web
        run: npm run build

      - name: Deploy to Vercel (production)
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master')
        uses: amondnet/vercel-action@v25
        with:
          vercel-token: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
          vercel-org-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }}
          vercel-project-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID }}
          working-directory: web
          vercel-args: "--prod"
          vercel-version: "56.4.0"

      - name: Deploy to Vercel (preview)
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: amondnet/vercel-action@v25
        with:
          vercel-token: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
          vercel-org-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }}
          vercel-project-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID }}
          working-directory: web
          vercel-version: "56.4.0"

templates.name: OpenCode Code Review
templates.content:
name: OpenCode Code Review

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      focus:
        description: "Focus area for the review (e.g. 'backend API', 'DSP modules')"
        required: false
        type: string
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * 1" # Monday 06:00 UTC

concurrency:
  group: opencode-review
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  issues-to-todo:
    name: Sync issues to todo.md
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: true

      - name: Configure git identity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Fetch open issues and write to todo.md
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |-
          ISSUES=$(gh issue list --state open --json number,title,labels \
            --jq '.[] | "\(.number)\t\(.title)\t\([.labels[].name] | join(","))"')

          if [ -z "$ISSUES" ]; then
            echo "No open issues found"
            exit 0
          fi

          if [ ! -f todo.md ]; then
            echo "# Todo" > todo.md
            echo "" >> todo.md
          fi

          echo "$ISSUES" > /tmp/issues.txt
          cat > /tmp/sync-prompt.txt <<'EOF'
          Lies todo.md und füge offene GitHub-Issues hinzu.

          Offene Issues (aus der GitHub API):
          EOF
          cat /tmp/issues.txt >> /tmp/sync-prompt.txt
          cat >> /tmp/sync-prompt.txt <<'EOF'

          Regeln:
          1. Lies todo.md vollständig
          2. Füge jedes Issue als '- [ ] #<number> <title> [<labels>]' hinzu
          3. Überspringe Issues, die bereits in todo.md existieren (gleiche Nummer)
          4. Behalte die bestehende Struktur bei
          5. Speichere die Änderungen in todo.md
          6. Committen Sie die Datei
          EOF

      - name: Sync issues into todo.md (AI)
        uses: OseMine/workflows/.github/actions/opencode@v1
        with:
          provider: ${{ vars.AI_PROVIDER || 'opencode' }}
          model: ${{ vars.AI_MODEL || 'auto-free' }}
          api-key: ${{ vars.AI_API_KEY || secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
          fallback-provider: ${{ vars.AI_FALLBACK_PROVIDER || 'opencode' }}
          fallback-model: ${{ vars.AI_FALLBACK_MODEL || 'auto-free' }}
          fallback-api-key: ${{ secrets.AI_API_KEY || secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
          prompt-file: /tmp/sync-prompt.txt
          git-identity: GitHub Actions <github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

      - name: Push todo.md
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain todo.md)" ]; then
            git add todo.md
            git commit -m "chore: sync open issues to todo.md"
            git push origin HEAD
          fi

  review:
    name: Code review
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: issues-to-todo
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: true

      - name: Configure git identity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Run OpenCode review
        uses: OseMine/workflows/.github/actions/opencode@v1
        id: review
        with:
          provider: ${{ vars.AI_PROVIDER || 'opencode' }}
          model: ${{ vars.AI_MODEL || 'auto-free' }}
          api-key: ${{ vars.AI_API_KEY || secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
          fallback-provider: ${{ vars.AI_FALLBACK_PROVIDER || 'opencode' }}
          fallback-model: ${{ vars.AI_FALLBACK_MODEL || 'auto-free' }}
          fallback-api-key: ${{ secrets.AI_API_KEY || secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
          agent: ${{ vars.REVIEW_AGENT || 'build' }}
          timeout-minutes: "55"
          git-identity: GitHub Actions <github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
          prompt: |
            Automated code review of this project.
            Focus area: ${{ github.event.inputs.focus || 'the entire project' }}

            Steps:
            1. Read README.md, package.json/Cargo.toml, and all source code.
               Read existing todo.md if present.
            2. Find bugs, missing features, and improvement suggestions.
               Verify suspicions by running tests where possible.
            3. Write the review as a dated section in todo.md (or
               reports/review-YYYY-MM-DD.md). Start writing early, don't
               wait until the end.
            4. Append new findings as a dated section at the top of todo.md.
               Leave existing entries untouched.
            5. Check which items in todo.md are done, mark them as completed
               [x] and move finished items to archived-todo.md.
            6. Review open GitHub issues. Add open issues to todos and close
               resolved ones.

            Rules:
            - Only modify todo.md and reports/. No application code changes.
            - No git operations (commit, push, PRs, merges, branch deletes).
            - No GitHub API calls. No destructive actions.
            - Every finding must include concrete file/function names.
            - If no new findings exist, state that explicitly in the report.

      - name: Create pull request with review results
        if: always()
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          branch: review/opencode-${{ github.run_id }}
          commit-message: "chore: opencode review report"
          title: "chore: opencode review report"
          body: |
            Automated review report from OpenCode.

            - Contains only changes to todo.md and reports/.
            - Please review and merge.
          delete-branch: true

  review-prs:
    name: Review & merge PRs
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: true

      - name: Configure git identity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: List open PRs
        id: prs
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          PRS=$(gh pr list --state open --json number,title,headRefName \
            --jq '.[] | "\(.number)\t\(.title)\t\(.headRefName)"')
          echo "prs<<EOF" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "$PRS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "EOF" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "$PRS" > /tmp/prs.txt

      - name: Build PR review prompt
        if: steps.prs.outputs.prs != ''
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > /tmp/pr-review-prompt.txt <<'EOF'
          For each open pull request below:
          1. git fetch origin pull/<number>/head:pr-<number>
          2. git checkout pr-<number>
          3. Review the PR. Evaluate: 1) Code correctness, 2) Project conventions,
             3) Security.
          4. Decide: MERGE / APPROVE / REJECT.
          5. Apply the decision with the gh CLI (GITHUB_TOKEN is set):
             - MERGE   -> gh pr merge <number> --squash --delete-branch
             - APPROVE -> gh pr review <number> --approve --body "<one-line rationale>"
             - REJECT  -> gh pr comment <number> --body "Automated review: <rationale>"
          6. git checkout main || git checkout master

          Open PRs (number, title, headRef):
          EOF
          cat /tmp/prs.txt >> /tmp/pr-review-prompt.txt

      - name: Review open PRs (AI)
        if: steps.prs.outputs.prs != ''
        uses: OseMine/workflows/.github/actions/opencode@v1
        with:
          provider: ${{ vars.AI_PROVIDER || 'opencode' }}
          model: ${{ vars.AI_MODEL || 'auto-free' }}
          api-key: ${{ vars.AI_API_KEY || secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
          fallback-provider: ${{ vars.AI_FALLBACK_PROVIDER || 'opencode' }}
          fallback-model: ${{ vars.AI_FALLBACK_MODEL || 'auto-free' }}
          fallback-api-key: ${{ secrets.AI_API_KEY || secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
          timeout-minutes: "55"
          git-identity: GitHub Actions <github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
          prompt-file: /tmp/pr-review-prompt.txt

  branch-cleanup:
    name: Delete stale branches
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: true

      - name: Delete merged branches
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          git fetch --prune 2>/dev/null || true
          MERGED=$(git branch -r --merged origin/main 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'origin/main' | grep -v 'origin/master' | sed 's|origin/||' || true)

          for branch in $MERGED; do
            case "$branch" in
              main|master|develop|dev|staging|production) continue ;;
            esac
            echo "Deleting merged branch: $branch"
            git push origin --delete "$branch" 2>&1 || echo "Failed to delete $branch"
          done

      - name: Delete stale branches (>90 days)
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          BRANCHES=$(gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches --paginate --jq '.[].name' 2>/dev/null || true)
          CUTOFF=$(date -d "90 days ago" --utc +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ 2>/dev/null || date -v-90d +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ 2>/dev/null || true)

          for branch in $BRANCHES; do
            case "$branch" in
              main|master|develop|dev|staging|production) continue ;;
            esac
            LAST_COMMIT=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/$branch" --jq '.commit.commit.author.date' 2>/dev/null || true)
            if [ -n "$LAST_COMMIT" ] && [ -n "$CUTOFF" ] && [[ "$LAST_COMMIT" < "$CUTOFF" ]]; then
              echo "Deleting stale branch: $branch (last: $LAST_COMMIT)"
              git push origin --delete "$branch" 2>&1 || echo "Failed to delete $branch"
            fi
          done

templates.name: OpenCode Todo-to-Issues
templates.content:
name: OpenCode Todo-to-Issues

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      focus:
        description: "Optional: only process this section/title from todo.md (substring match)"
        required: false
        type: string
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * 3" # Wednesday 06:00 UTC

concurrency:
  group: opencode-todo-issues
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: write
  issues: write

jobs:
  create-issues:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: true

      - name: Configure git identity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Run opencode to create issues from todo.md
        uses: OseMine/workflows/.github/actions/opencode@v1
        with:
          provider: ${{ vars.AI_PROVIDER || 'opencode' }}
          model: ${{ vars.AI_MODEL || 'auto-free' }}
          api-key: ${{ vars.AI_API_KEY || secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
          fallback-provider: ${{ vars.AI_FALLBACK_PROVIDER || 'opencode' }}
          fallback-model: ${{ vars.AI_FALLBACK_MODEL || 'auto-free' }}
          fallback-api-key: ${{ secrets.AI_API_KEY || secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
          timeout-minutes: "18"
          git-identity: GitHub Actions <github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
          prompt: |
            Task: Create GitHub issues from open tasks in todo.md.

            Steps:
            1. Check if todo.md exists. If not, exit immediately with a short
               message ("No todo.md found") and create NO issues.
            2. Read todo.md fully. Collect all open tasks (marked with "- [ ]"
               checkboxes) and any items noted as "Tracking open GitHub issues".
               Focus area (optional): ${{ github.event.inputs.focus || 'all open items' }}
            3. Group related items into logical issues (one issue per logical
               task, not one per line).
            4. For each group, create exactly ONE GitHub issue with:
               - Descriptive title (short, clear)
               - Body containing: context, affected files/functions (with line
                 numbers from todo.md), acceptance criteria, and the todo.md text.
            5. Assign appropriate labels using `gh issue create --label`:
               - Bug/security issue -> `bug` (+ `security` for security findings)
               - New feature -> `enhancement`
               - Performance -> `perf`
               - UX/Design -> `ux`
               - Documentation -> `documentation`
               - CI/Workflows/Build -> `ci`
               Create missing labels first with `gh label create`. If label
               creation fails (e.g. 403), create the issue with the best
               matching existing label and note this in the summary.
            6. Use the GitHub API via $GITHUB_TOKEN (the gh CLI is
               authenticated as GitHub Actions).
            7. Skip duplicates -- list existing issues first and compare titles.

            IMPORTANT:
            - Do NOT modify any files, commit anything, or create a pull request.
            - Every created issue MUST have at least one matching label.
            - Respond with a summary of created issues (number, title, label)
              and skipped duplicates.

templates.name: Release
templates.description: Thin release workflow - copy into any project, set `language` + optional
templates.content:
# Thin release workflow - copy into any project, set `language` + optional
# `build` flags. Everything (meta/semver, builds, security gate, AI release
# notes, release + SHA256SUMS) lives in the shared `release-all` action.
#
# -- Pin vs rolling tag policy ------------------------------------------
#   @v1      stable - receives non-breaking fixes; recommended for production
#   @latest  rolling - latest published state; friendly to new features
#   @main    branch head - bleeding edge; only for testing
# When a fix ships here, main moves first, then v1 is updated. Internal
# cross-references in this library are pinned to @v1, so whatever you pin,
# the whole tree stays consistent. Change the ref below (and in
# release-all's sibling steps) when you want new behaviour.
#
# Primary trigger: workflow_dispatch (Actions tab → Run workflow).
# Version is auto-detected from pubspec.yaml / Cargo.toml / package.json, or
# override via the `version` input. Tag push (`v*`) remains supported as a
# secondary trigger.
name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: "Version to release (e.g. 1.2.3). Empty = auto-detect from project files"
        required: false
        type: string
      prerelease:
        description: "Mark as prerelease"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      draft:
        description: "Create as draft"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      build:
        description: "Comma-separated build flags: cargo, tauri, plugin, installer, python, android, ios, flutter, c, cpp, csharp, java, all"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: all
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]

permissions:
  contents: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  release:
    name: Release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: OseMine/workflows/.github/actions/release-all@v1
        with:
          language: auto            # auto | rust | tauri | node | python | flutter | kmp | c | cpp | csharp | maven | gradle
          build: ${{ github.event.inputs.build || 'all' }}
          release-tag: ${{ github.event.inputs.version && format('v{0}', github.event.inputs.version) || '' }}
          min-rating: "7"           # security gate 0-10; 0 disables
          draft: ${{ github.event.inputs.draft || 'false' }}
          prerelease: ${{ github.event.inputs.prerelease || 'false' }}

          # -- AI provider for the SECURITY GATE -------------------------
          provider: ${{ vars.AI_PROVIDER || 'opencode' }}            # opencode | google | openai | mistral | anthropic | x | deepseek | groq | puter | ollama
          model: ${{ vars.AI_MODEL || 'auto-free' }}
          api-key: ${{ secrets.AI_API_KEY || secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
          fallback-provider: ${{ vars.AI_FALLBACK_PROVIDER || 'opencode' }}
          fallback-model: ${{ vars.AI_FALLBACK_MODEL || 'auto-free' }}
          fallback-api-key: ${{ secrets.AI_API_KEY || secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}

          # -- AI provider for RELEASE NOTES (optional, overrides above) -
          # Use a different provider/model for notes (e.g. mistral for a
          # fast model) while the security gate keeps the generic one.
          # notes-mode: auto           # auto | file | ai-required
          # notes-file: CHANGELOG.md   # used only when AI fails (auto mode)
          # notes-provider: mistral
          # notes-model: codestral
          # notes-api-key: ${{ secrets.MISTRAL_API_KEY }}
          # notes-fallback-provider: opencode
          # notes-fallback-model: auto-free
          # notes-fallback-api-key: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}

          # --- custom OpenAI-compatible API (optional, replaces provider/model above) ---
          # provider: custom
          # model: my-model          # model id your API accepts
          # custom-api-base: https://api.example.com/v1
          # custom-api-key: ${{ secrets.CUSTOM_API_KEY }}

templates.name: Security
templates.description: Thin security gate — copy into any project, wire OpenAI/Puter/VirusTotal
templates.content:
# Thin security gate — copy into any project, wire OpenAI/Puter/VirusTotal
# secrets, done. Trivy + cargo/npm audit + PHP hint + VirusTotal scan + AI
# review, rating 0-10, fails the run below min-rating.
name: Security

on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * 1" # Monday 06:00 UTC

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  security:
    name: Security gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: OseMine/workflows/.github/actions/security@v1
        with:
          min-rating: "7"
          provider: ${{ vars.AI_PROVIDER || 'opencode' }}            # opencode | google | openai | mistral | anthropic | x | deepseek | groq | puter | ollama
          model: ${{ vars.AI_MODEL || 'auto-free' }}
          api-key: ${{ secrets.AI_API_KEY || secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
          fallback-provider: ${{ vars.AI_FALLBACK_PROVIDER || 'opencode' }}
          fallback-model: ${{ vars.AI_FALLBACK_MODEL || 'auto-free' }}
          fallback-api-key: ${{ secrets.AI_API_KEY || secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
          # --- custom OpenAI-compatible API (optional, replaces provider/model above) ---
          # provider: custom
          # model: my-model          # model id your API accepts
          # custom-api-base: https://api.example.com/v1
          # custom-api-key: ${{ secrets.CUSTOM_API_KEY }}
          virustotal-api-key: ${{ secrets.VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY }} # optional (VIRUSTOTAL badge)
          virustotal-files: "target/release/*.exe dist/*.exe *.exe" # space-separated globs
          test-cmd: "cargo test"                                 # optional verification
